modules.tradition: Aboriginal Australian & Torres Strait Islander (Boorong/Stanbridge 1857, the Emu in the Sky, Tagai, heliacal horizon calendars)
African traditions (Ifá/Yorùbá Odù · Akan day-souls · Ethiopian Baḥire Ḥasab · Coptic · Dogon/Sirius · Swahili nautical manāzil · isiLimela heliacal risings)
Astrocartography (Jim Lewis): planetary MC/IC/AS/DS lines and a place's distance to them
Babylonian & Egyptian (Enuma Anu Enlil omens, Goal-Year periods, MUL.APIN paths, 36 decans, Egyptian bounds, dodekatemoria)
Chinese (BaZi four pillars, Wu Xing, 24 jieqi, 28 xiu, Nine Star Ki)
East Asian deep: Vietnamese Tử Vi (Purple Star), Korean Saju sipseong, Japanese Shukuyō · Rokuyō · Onmyōdō · Sanmeigaku, Mongolian Zurkhai, Chinese almanac additions
Harmonics, symmetry and alternative zodiacs (Addey/Hamblin harmonics, Kepler-Addey minor aspects, declination, antiscia, Ebertin dial midpoints, draconic, heliocentric, fixed stars)
Hellenistic & classical Western (Ptolemy, Vettius Valens, Dorotheus, Paulus Alexandrinus)
Houses and angles (Placidus cusps, the lord of the seventh, the synastry house overlay)
Indigenous American beyond Mesoamerica (Inca Collca & the 328-day ceque calendar, Diné, Pawnee, Lakota, Hopi horizon calendar, Mapuche We Tripantu, eastern-woodland moons)
Lunar cycles, eclipses and the religious calendars (manazil, nakshatra, xiu, Saros, computus, Hebrew, Hijri, Zoroastrian)
Mesoamerican (Maya Tzolk'in/Haab/Long Count at GMT 584283, Aztec tonalpohualli, Dreamspell)
Modern & psychological Western (element balance, aspect patterns, asteroid synastry, composite)
Persian & medieval Arabic (Abu Ma'shar, al-Biruni, Ibn Ezra, Bonatti's firdaria)
Tibetan, Burmese, Thai, Javanese and Balinese (nagtsi, Mahabote, rerk, Pawukon wetonan)
Uranian / Hamburg School (Witte, Sieggruen, Rudolph) & Ebertin cosmobiology
Vedic quantitative Jyotisha: Ashtakavarga bindus, Shadbala in rupas, the upagrahas and the Jaimini arudha padas
Vedic / Jyotisha core (Parashara BPHS, Muhurta Ashtakoota, Jaimini chara karakas)
Vedic marriage matching (Ashtakoot / Guna Milan 36 points, Kuja dosha, ten Poruthams)
